frames.title: Global Temperature Anomalies from 1880 to 2023
frames.alt: NASA's 2023 world map of surface temperature anomalies, with warm anomalies in red and cool anomalies in blue.
frames.details: NASA identifies this final map as the 2023 annual anomaly. The preceding frames in the source movie use a running 24-month window. Robinson projection, 1951–1980 baseline.

frames.title: Global Temperature Anomalies from 1880 to 2024
frames.alt: NASA's 2024 world map of surface temperature anomalies, with widespread red and orange areas.
frames.details: NASA identifies this final map as the 2024 annual anomaly. The preceding frames in the source movie use a running 24-month window. Robinson projection, 1951–1980 baseline.

frames.title: Global Temperature Anomalies from 1880 to 2025
frames.alt: NASA's unsmoothed 2025 world map of surface temperature anomalies, with orange and red patches and smaller blue regions.
frames.details: NASA's 2025 annual map without spatial smoothing, in Robinson projection. Colors follow NASA's published vik scale and the 1951–1980 baseline.
